title: coap_keys_settings: BUILD_ASSERT guard for MAX_ENTRIES vs 2-digit record keys
description: Edge-case review finding (u4fr round): parse_record_key() hard-codes exactly two entry digits (coap_keys_settings.c:141-145) and rejects e100+; make_key() uses %02d (coap_keys_settings.c:~292) which silently widens past two digits. If CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES were ever raised above 100, saves would write records that fail load with -EBADMSG on every boot. Latent only: Kconfig range is 4 16 (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/Kconfig ~line 258), so unreachable today. Cheap insurance: BUILD_ASSERT(CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES <= 100) near make_key/parse, or a Kconfig-level comment. Not urgent.
